generic.Defined scope/population: The quote version the broker is binding and every condition printed on that quote letter
generic.In-scope period: From quote issue date through the requested bind effective date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Quote expiry date, quote status and quote version number present on the quote record
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of conditions on the quote letter equals the count marked Met or Outstanding
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validity file note saved against the quote with version number and check date and time
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lapsed or superseded quotes logged with the re-date or re-quote decision and reason
generic.Test population: All bind transactions executed in the period from quotes held in the underwriting workstation
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero binds executed against expired, withdrawn or superseded quote versions
generic.Exception handling path: Expired quote referred to the Underwriter for re-date or re-quote before the bind proceeds
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Status Quoted, expiry on or after bind date and version matching the broker bind order
generic.Evidence location: Quote record and validity file note in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Open the quote record in the underwriting workstation
sop: Search the underwriting workstation by submission number and open the quote being bound.
Confirm the insured legal name and risk address match the broker bind instruction.
Done when the correct quote record is open and matched to the bind instruction.
verify: Compare the submission number on the open quote to the number on the bind order.
Pass when the open quote is the one named in the bind instruction.

steps.title: Read the Quote Expiry date field against today's date
sop: Read the Quote Expiry date on the quote header and compare it to the bind date.
Compare the expiry date to the requested effective date as well as the instruction date.
Done when expiry has been compared to both the bind date and the effective date.
verify: Confirm the recorded expiry date falls on or after the bind date.
Pass when the quote is unexpired on the bind date.

steps.title: Confirm quote status is Quoted or Open in the workstation
sop: Read the status field and confirm it shows Quoted or Open.
Reject any quote showing Expired, Withdrawn or Superseded and tell the Underwriter.
Done when the quote status has been read and accepted or rejected.
verify: Re-read the status field after refreshing the quote record.
Pass when status is Quoted or Open with no superseding revision present.

steps.title: Match the quote version number to the version the broker accepted
sop: Read the version number on the workstation quote and on the accepted quote letter.
List all versions on the submission and confirm no later revision replaces it.
Done when the accepted version and the system version are confirmed identical.
verify: Identify the latest quote version on the submission record.
Pass when the version being bound is the version the broker accepted.

steps.title: Mark each quote condition Met or Outstanding on the bind checklist
sop: Copy every condition printed on the quote letter into the bind checklist.
Set each condition to Met where evidence exists, otherwise Outstanding with an owner.
Raise any Outstanding condition that blocks cover with the broker before release.
Done when every quote condition carries a Met or Outstanding disposition.
verify: Count conditions on the quote letter against dispositions on the checklist.
Pass when the counts agree with no condition left undispositioned.

steps.title: Re-date or re-quote a lapsed quote in the underwriting workstation
sop: Where the quote has lapsed, decide between a re-date and a re-quote on current rates.
Apply the re-date or generate the new quote version in the workstation.
Record the extension reason and rate basis used in the file note.
Done when a valid in-date quote version exists for the bind.
verify: Check the extension reason is present for every re-dated quote.
Pass when no lapsed quote is bound without a recorded extension reason.

steps.title: Record the validity confirmation on the submission in the policy administration system
sop: Write the confirmation note naming quote version, expiry date and condition status.
Save the note against the submission so it carries into the policy record.
Done when the confirmation note is saved and visible on the submission.
verify: Reopen the submission and read the saved confirmation note.
Pass when the note names version, expiry date and condition status.

generic.Defined scope/population: The signed application and broker bind order for this submission plus any co-applicant signatures
generic.In-scope period: From application signature date through the requested policy effective date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Applicant signature, signature date, submission index and bind order terms captured on file
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Two required documents indexed to the submission match the two bind checklist items ticked
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed application PDF and DocuSign certificate stored with envelope completion timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing or unsigned applications logged with chase date and the resolution recorded
generic.Test population: All bound submissions in the period requiring a signed application and broker order
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero binds recorded where the signed application is missing or unsigned
generic.Exception handling path: Missing or undated signature chased with the broker and the bind held by the Underwriter
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Application signed on or before effective date and order naming insured, dates, limits and premium
generic.Evidence location: OpenText Document Mgmt indexed by submission number with the workstation bind checklist

steps.title: Locate the signed application in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Search OpenText by submission number for the signed application document type.
Open the PDF and confirm it is the final application and not a draft proposal form.
Done when the signed application is located and indexed to this submission.
verify: Check the index metadata carries the submission number and document type.
Pass when the signed application is retrievable by submission number.

steps.title: Check applicant signature and signature date on the application
sop: Confirm each required signature block is completed by the applicant or authorised officer.
Confirm the signature date is on or before the requested effective date.
Done when signatures and dates are confirmed present and in date order.
verify: Compare the signature date to the requested effective date on the bind order.
Pass when no signature is missing and no date falls after the effective date.

steps.title: Verify the DocuSign certificate of completion is attached
sop: Open the DocuSign envelope for e-signed applications and export the completion certificate.
Confirm signer identity and completion timestamp appear on the certificate.
Attach the certificate to the submission alongside the signed application.
Done when the audit certificate is filed with the e-signed application.
verify: Check every e-signed application on the submission has a matching certificate.
Pass when no e-signed application is filed without its certificate.

steps.title: Confirm the broker bind order content in the underwriting workstation
sop: Read the named insured, effective date, limits and premium from the broker instruction.
Compare each of those to the quote being bound and note any difference.
Refer any discrepancy to the Underwriter before proceeding.
Done when order content is compared to the quote and differences raised.
verify: Re-check insured name, effective date, limits and premium against the accepted quote.
Pass when all four agree or the difference is documented and accepted.

steps.title: Index both documents to the submission in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Upload or re-index the signed application and bind order under the submission number.
Apply the correct document type codes so retention and retrieval rules apply.
Done when both documents are indexed and retrievable by submission number.
verify: Search the repository by submission number and count the indexed items.
Pass when both the application and the bind order return in the search.

steps.title: Tick the Signed Application and Bind Order items on the bind checklist
sop: Open the bind checklist in the underwriting workstation for this submission.
Tick both items and record the document reference against each tick.
Done when both checklist items are ticked with references recorded.
verify: Reopen the checklist and look for unticked mandatory document items.
Pass when the checklist shows both items complete with references.

steps.title: Hold the bind and chase any missing or unsigned document
sop: Where a document is missing or unsigned, hold the bind and notify the broker in writing.
Log the chase date and expected return date on the submission.
Release the bind only once the outstanding document is received and indexed.
Done when every exception is closed or the bind remains held.
verify: Review the exception log for open items against bound policies.
Pass when no policy is bound with an open signed-application exception.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every syndicated or shared-line placement where our carrier writes less than the full order
generic.In-scope period: From placement slip circulation through the bind date of the shared program
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Participant names, written line percentages and signed lines captured on the placement slip
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Signed lines across all participants total 100% of the placed order before bind
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed slip and sign-off correspondence filed with signature dates and slip version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Short or over-placed orders logged with the resolution and the co-underwriter who agreed it
generic.Test population: All shared-line or syndicated risks bound in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero shared-line binds released without lead or co-underwriter sign-off on file
generic.Exception handling path: Short-placed order referred to the Senior Underwriter to reduce the order or find capacity
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Signed slip totalling 100% with our net signed line inside the binding underwriter authority
generic.Evidence location: Placement slip and sign-offs in OpenText with the Shared Line flag in the workstation

steps.title: List participants and written lines from the placement slip in the workstation
sop: Read the placement slip and list each co-insurer or syndicate with its written line percentage.
Record the participant list against the submission in the underwriting workstation.
Done when every participant and its written line is recorded on the submission.
verify: Compare the recorded participant list to the slip line by line.
Pass when every slip participant appears on the submission record.

steps.title: Total the signed lines and confirm 100% placement
sop: Sum the signed line percentages across all participants including our own share.
Compare the total to 100% of the placed order and note any shortfall or over-placement.
Done when the signed line total is calculated and compared to 100%.
verify: Recompute the signed line total independently of the first calculation.
Pass when signed lines total exactly 100% of the placed order.

steps.title: Obtain co-underwriter or lead sign-off for each participation
sop: Request the lead or co-underwriter sign-off email or stamped slip for each participation.
Confirm the sign-off names the risk, the period and the share being agreed.
Chase any participant whose sign-off is outstanding before the bind date.
Done when a sign-off is held for every shared participation.
verify: Match each participant on the slip to a held sign-off document.
Pass when no participation is left without a sign-off.

steps.title: Check our net signed line against the binding underwriter authority
sop: Calculate our net signed line in limit and premium terms after reinsurance.
Compare it to the authority band of the underwriter releasing the bind.
Refer to UW Operations where the net line exceeds that authority.
Done when the net line is confirmed inside authority or referred upward.
verify: Re-check the authority band recorded for the binding underwriter.
Pass when the net signed line sits inside the recorded authority.

steps.title: Attach the signed slip and sign-off correspondence in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Upload the signed slip and each sign-off email against the submission number.
Apply the shared-line document type so the pack is retrievable as a set.
Done when the slip and all sign-offs are filed against the submission.
verify: Retrieve the shared-line pack from the repository by submission number.
Pass when the slip and every sign-off return in the retrieval.

steps.title: Set the Shared Line Sign-off flag in the underwriting workstation
sop: Review the slip, the sign-offs and the net line calculation on the submission.
Set the Shared Line Sign-off flag so the bind can be released.
Done when the flag is set and the reviewer is recorded.
verify: Confirm the flag records the reviewer name and date.
Pass when no shared-line bind proceeds without the flag set.

generic.Defined scope/population: All bind requests and binder instructions received from brokers, MGAs or insureds on this risk
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the bind instruction through the requested effective date and time
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Received date and time, requesting party, producer code, quote number and effective date
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of logged bind requests matches instructions received in the portal and email channels
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Original portal or email instruction filed with its received timestamp on the submission
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Backdated, same-day and verbal instructions logged with referral or written confirmation outcome
generic.Test population: All bind requests logged in the period across portal, email and verbal channels
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero verbal binders left undocumented beyond 24 hours of instruction
generic.Exception handling path: Backdated or same-day requests referred to the Underwriter before the request is actioned
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Request logged with originating broker, producer code and the correct quote number and option
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation submission log and the workflow case management tool work item

steps.title: Retrieve the bind instruction from the Broker & Agent Portal or inbox
sop: Open the portal instruction or broker email carrying the bind request.
Save the instruction against the submission so the original wording is retained.
Done when the original instruction is saved against the submission.
verify: Open the saved instruction from the submission record.
Pass when the original wording is retrievable from the submission.

steps.title: Log the request in the underwriting workstation with received date and time
sop: Create the bind request log entry and enter the date and time the instruction arrived.
Use the channel timestamp rather than the time the entry is keyed.
Done when the received date and time are recorded on the submission.
verify: Compare the logged time to the email or portal timestamp.
Pass when the logged time matches the channel timestamp.

steps.title: Record the requesting party and producer code on the request
sop: Identify whether the instruction came from the broker, the MGA or the insured directly.
Enter the requesting party and the producer code shown on the instruction.
Done when requesting party and producer code are recorded.
verify: Check the recorded producer code against the producer record on the submission.
Pass when the recorded code matches the submission producer.

steps.title: Check the requested effective date and time and flag backdating
sop: Read the requested effective date and time of day from the instruction.
Flag any request effective before today or effective the same day for referral.
Route flagged requests to the Underwriter before taking further action.
Done when the effective date is recorded and any backdating is flagged.
verify: Review flagged requests against the referral log.
Pass when every backdated or same-day request carries a referral.

steps.title: Confirm the request references the correct quote number and option
sop: Match the quote number on the instruction to a quote held on this submission.
Confirm whether primary or alternative terms are being bound and record the option.
Query any ambiguous option with the broker before logging it as accepted.
Done when the quote number and option are confirmed and recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded option to the quote options held on the submission.
Pass when the recorded option matches an existing quote option.

steps.title: Document verbal instructions and confirm back in writing within 24 hours
sop: Write the file note for any verbal binder capturing caller, time and terms instructed.
Send the written confirmation to the broker within 24 hours of the instruction.
File the sent confirmation against the submission.
Done when every verbal instruction has a file note and written confirmation.
verify: Compare verbal instruction times to written confirmation send times.
Pass when no verbal binder is left unconfirmed beyond 24 hours.

steps.title: Raise the bind work item in the workflow case management tool
sop: Create the bind work item with the target bind date and assign the responsible underwriter.
Attach the logged instruction and any referral to the work item.
Done when the work item is created, assigned and carries the instruction.
verify: Check the work item queue for unassigned bind requests.
Pass when every logged bind request has an owned work item.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every subjectivity raised on the quote for this risk, whether cleared or carried past bind
generic.In-scope period: From quote issue through bind date and the compliance dates of carried subjectivities
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Subjectivity text, status, evidence reference, responsible underwriter and due date populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of quote subjectivities equals register lines marked Cleared or Carried
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Evidence documents in OpenText with a reconciliation file note dated before the bind
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Carried subjectivities logged as condition precedent or warranty with owner and due date
generic.Test population: All risks bound in the period that carried one or more quote subjectivities
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero subjectivities left Open with no owner after the bind is executed
generic.Exception handling path: Uncleared critical subjectivity converted to a condition precedent or the bind is held
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every item Cleared with evidence or Carried with owner, due date and policy wording
generic.Evidence location: Subjectivity register in the underwriting workstation with evidence in OpenText Document Mgmt

steps.title: Open the subjectivity list on the quote in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the quote and list each subjectivity with its current status.
Copy the list into the subjectivity register used for the bind reconciliation.
Done when every quote subjectivity appears on the register.
verify: Count the subjectivities on the quote and on the register.
Pass when the two counts agree.

steps.title: Match each cleared subjectivity to evidence in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: For each item marked cleared, locate the supporting document in the repository.
Record the document reference against the register line.
Reopen any item where the evidence cannot be located.
Done when every cleared item carries an evidence reference.
verify: Spot-retrieve evidence documents from the recorded references.
Pass when every cleared item resolves to a retrievable document.

steps.title: Convert carried subjectivities into policy conditions in the workstation
sop: For each subjectivity carried past bind, select condition precedent or warranty wording.
Attach the wording to the bound terms so it prints on the policy.
Done when every carried subjectivity has policy wording attached.
verify: Compare carried register items to the conditions attached to the bound terms.
Pass when each carried item maps to attached policy wording.

steps.title: Set diary follow-ups and owners for carried subjectivities
sop: Set a diary date for each carried subjectivity based on its compliance deadline.
Name the responsible underwriter on each diary entry.
Done when every carried item has a diary date and a named owner.
verify: Review the register for carried items with no owner or no date.
Pass when no carried item lacks an owner or a due date.

steps.title: Mark the subjectivity register Complete in the underwriting workstation
sop: Review the register and confirm every line is Cleared or Carried.
Set the register status to Complete for this bind.
Done when the register status is Complete with no Open lines.
verify: Filter the register for lines still in Open status.
Pass when the Open filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Record the reconciliation file note before authorising the bind
sop: Write the file note summarising cleared and carried subjectivities and evidence held.
Save the note against the submission dated before the bind timestamp.
Done when the reconciliation note is saved ahead of the bind.
verify: Compare the note timestamp to the bind timestamp on the transaction.
Pass when the note predates the bind.

generic.Defined scope/population: Named insured, additional insureds, parent entities and risk locations screened before this bind
generic.In-scope period: The 24 hours immediately preceding execution of the bind
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Screened entity names, screening reference number, run date and time and match disposition
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of insured parties on the risk equals the count of entities in the screening run
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Screening result retained with run timestamp and list version against the submission
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each potential match logged as true hit or false positive with reason and adjudicator
generic.Test population: All policies bound in the period requiring a pre-bind sanctions screen
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero policies bound with an unadjudicated potential sanctions match outstanding
generic.Exception handling path: True hit escalated to Compliance and the bind held until written clearance is received
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Clear screening result for every screened party dated within 24 hours of the bind
generic.Evidence location: Sanctions screening system case record with the result filed on the workstation submission

steps.title: Build the screening party list from the underwriting workstation
sop: List the named insured, all additional insureds and any parent or affiliate entity.
Use the exact legal names as they will print on the policy.
Done when the full party list for screening is compiled.
verify: Compare the party list to the insured records on the submission.
Pass when every insured party on the risk appears on the list.

steps.title: Re-run the screen in the sanctions screening system within 24 hours of bind
sop: Submit the party list to the screening system within 24 hours of the planned bind.
Record the screening reference number and the run timestamp.
Done when the screen has run and the reference number is captured.
verify: Check the run timestamp against the planned bind time.
Pass when the screen ran within 24 hours of the bind.

steps.title: Screen risk location country and overseas operations for jurisdiction exposure
sop: Screen the risk location country and any declared overseas operations.
Compare each against the comprehensive-sanctions jurisdiction list in the system.
Flag exposure to a comprehensively sanctioned jurisdiction for referral.
Done when all locations and territories have been screened.
verify: Review the location schedule against the screened jurisdictions.
Pass when no risk location is left unscreened.

steps.title: Adjudicate each potential match in the sanctions screening system
sop: Open each potential match and compare name, date of birth, address and identifiers.
Record the disposition as true hit or false positive with the reason for the decision.
Done when every potential match carries a recorded disposition.
verify: Filter the screening case for undispositioned matches.
Pass when no potential match remains undispositioned.

steps.title: Escalate true hits to Compliance and hold the bind in the workstation
sop: Escalate any true hit to Compliance with the screening reference and supporting detail.
Hold the bind in the workstation until written clearance is received.
File the Compliance clearance against the submission before releasing the bind.
Done when every true hit has written clearance or the bind stays held.
verify: Check bound risks against the true hit escalation log.
Pass when no risk is bound with an unresolved true hit.

steps.title: Attach the clear screening result to the submission before bind authorisation
sop: Export the clear screening result and attach it to the submission in the workstation.
Record the screening reference number on the bind checklist.
Done when the clear result and reference are on the submission.
verify: Open the submission and confirm the result document and reference are present.
Pass when both are present and dated within 24 hours of the bind.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every scheduled location with an ordered survey and every protection warranty on the risk
generic.In-scope period: From survey order date through the bind date and each recommendation compliance date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Survey report reference, recommendation status, warranty wording code and compliance date
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of scheduled locations equals the count of survey reports held on file
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Survey reports and warranty confirmations filed in OpenText with report dates recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Open recommendations logged as completed, waived by underwriter or written as a warranty
generic.Test population: All bound risks in the period subject to survey or loss-control prerequisites
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero critical survey recommendations left without a warranty or a documented waiver
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved recommendation raised as a condition precedent with a compliance date by the Underwriter
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Survey on file per location and system warranty wording matching the wording quoted
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting workstation warranty fields with survey reports in OpenText Document Mgmt

steps.title: List ordered surveys against scheduled locations in the underwriting workstation
sop: List every scheduled location on the risk and the survey ordered for it.
Mark each location as report received or report outstanding.
Done when every scheduled location shows a survey status.
verify: Compare the location schedule count to the survey status count.
Pass when no scheduled location is missing a survey status.

steps.title: Retrieve each survey report from OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Retrieve the loss-control report for each surveyed location from the repository.
Confirm the report covers the correct address and is within the acceptable age.
Chase the surveyor where a report is missing or out of date.
Done when a current report is held for every surveyed location.
verify: Open each retrieved report and check the address and report date.
Pass when every location has a current report on file.

steps.title: Disposition each survey recommendation in the underwriting workstation
sop: List each recommendation and mark it completed, waived or converted to a warranty.
Record the reason for any waiver and the underwriter granting it.
Done when every recommendation carries one of the three dispositions.
verify: Filter recommendations for those with no disposition recorded.
Pass when no recommendation is left undispositioned.

steps.title: Check protection warranties against what the survey recorded
sop: Compare sprinkler, alarm and hot-work warranties to the protections the survey found.
Amend or remove any warranty the survey does not support.
Done when every protection warranty is supported by survey findings.
verify: Re-read the survey protection section against the warranty schedule.
Pass when no warranty contradicts the survey findings.

steps.title: Verify system warranty wording matches the wording on the quote
sop: Open the warranty wording selected in the underwriting workstation.
Compare the wording code and text to the warranty referenced on the quote.
Correct any mismatch before the bind is released.
Done when system wording and quoted wording are identical.
verify: Compare wording codes on the quote and the bound terms.
Pass when the codes and text agree.

steps.title: Record outstanding recommendations as conditions precedent before bind
sop: Raise any outstanding recommendation as a condition precedent with a compliance date.
Attach the condition to the bound terms so it prints on the policy.
File the recommendation tracking note against the submission.
Done when every outstanding recommendation is a dated condition precedent.
verify: Compare outstanding recommendations to conditions on the bound terms.
Pass when each outstanding item maps to a dated condition precedent.

generic.Defined scope/population: The producing agency and the individual producer placing this risk in the risk state
generic.In-scope period: The licence and appointment status as at the bind date and the policy effective date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: National producer number, licence status, licensed lines, state and appointment status
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of producers on the submission equals the count verified in NIPR for this bind
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: NIPR lookup result saved with verification date and NPN on the producer record
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lapsed, terminated or unlicensed producers logged with the hold or remediation outcome
generic.Test population: All new business bound in the period by producer and risk state
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero policies bound through a producer whose appointment is terminated or lapsed
generic.Exception handling path: Unlicensed or unappointed producer referred to UW Operations and the bind held
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Active licence covering the risk state and line plus an in-force appointment with our entity
generic.Evidence location: Producer record in the underwriting workstation with the NIPR result and portal producer profile

steps.title: Identify the producer and NPN from the Broker & Agent Portal record
sop: Open the producer profile linked to the submission in the broker portal.
Record the agency name, individual producer name and national producer number.
Done when the agency, producer and NPN are captured for lookup.
verify: Compare the captured NPN to the producer code on the submission.
Pass when the NPN resolves to the producer placing this risk.

steps.title: Look up the producer licence status in NIPR by national producer number
sop: Search NIPR by NPN and open the producer licence record.
Confirm the licence status reads Active and note the expiry date.
Done when the NIPR licence status has been read and recorded.
verify: Re-read the NIPR status field for the returned producer.
Pass when the licence status is Active on the bind date.

steps.title: Confirm the licence covers the risk state and line of business
sop: Read the licensed states and lines of authority on the NIPR record.
Confirm the risk state and the line being bound are both covered.
Hold the bind where either is missing and notify UW Operations.
Done when state and line coverage is confirmed or the bind is held.
verify: Compare the risk state and line on the submission to the licensed authorities.
Pass when both appear on the producer licence.

steps.title: Verify the appointment with our carrier entity is in force
sop: Check the appointment list for our underwriting entity in the risk state.
Confirm the appointment is in force and not terminated or lapsed.
Done when the appointment status with our entity is confirmed.
verify: Re-check the appointment effective and termination dates.
Pass when the appointment is in force on the bind date.

steps.title: Check dual licensing of agency and individual producer where required
sop: Determine whether the risk state requires both agency and individual licences.
Verify both licences where dual licensing applies.
Done when both licences are verified or dual licensing is confirmed not required.
verify: Compare the state requirement to the licences verified.
Pass when every licence the state requires has been verified.

steps.title: Record the verification date and NPN on the producer record in the workstation
sop: Review the NIPR evidence and record the verification date and NPN on the producer record.
Release the bind hold once licence and appointment checks are clear.
Done when the verification is recorded and the hold is released.
verify: Open the producer record and read the verification date and NPN.
Pass when both are recorded before the bind is released.

generic.Defined scope/population: The payment method, instalment schedule and premium payment warranty applying to this bind
generic.In-scope period: From bind date through the premium payment warranty date and final instalment due date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Payment method, deposit amount, instalment dates, warranty period and finance agreement details
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Deposit plus instalments on the billing account equal the bound premium including taxes
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Premium finance agreement and approval emails filed with dates against the submission
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Extended payment terms logged with the approver name and the approval date recorded
generic.Test population: All risks bound in the period carrying a premium payment warranty or finance arrangement
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero extended payment terms applied without documented approval before bind
generic.Exception handling path: Terms beyond the standard warranty period escalated to UW Operations for written approval
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Billing account showing agreed method, instalment schedule and warranty date before bind
generic.Evidence location: Billing/commission platform account record with the approval filed in the workstation

steps.title: Confirm the payment method and warranty period on the quote in the workstation
sop: Read the payment method on the quote and confirm agency bill or direct bill.
Read the premium payment warranty period stated on the quote terms.
Done when method and warranty period are confirmed from the quote.
verify: Compare the quoted method and warranty period to the bind instruction.
Pass when both match the terms the broker accepted.

steps.title: Check deposit and instalment amounts on the billing platform account
sop: Open the billing account and read the deposit or first instalment amount and due date.
Confirm the instalment schedule matches the plan agreed with the broker.
Done when the deposit and instalment schedule are confirmed on the account.
verify: Total the deposit and instalments and compare to the bound premium.
Pass when the schedule totals the bound premium including taxes.

steps.title: Verify the premium finance agreement names the correct insured and period
sop: Where premium finance is used, open the finance agreement held on file.
Confirm the insured legal name and the policy period on the agreement are correct.
Query any mismatch with the broker before the bind proceeds.
Done when the finance agreement is confirmed correct or queried.
verify: Compare insured name and policy period on the agreement to the bound terms.
Pass when both agree with the bound policy.

steps.title: Attach the premium payment warranty wording to the bound terms
sop: Select the premium payment warranty wording required for this class of risk.
Attach the wording so it prints on the policy and binder.
Done when the warranty wording is attached to the bound terms.
verify: Read the bound terms forms list for the warranty wording.
Pass when the required warranty wording is present.

steps.title: Escalate extended payment terms for approval before bind
sop: Identify any payment terms beyond the standard warranty period for this class.
Escalate to UW Operations with the rationale and the exposure at risk.
File the written approval against the submission before binding.
Done when extended terms are approved in writing or withdrawn.
verify: Check bound risks with extended terms against the approval file.
Pass when no extended terms exist without a filed approval.

sop: Upload the signed slip and treaty confirmation against the submission.

verify: Total the insured values entered and compare to the rated schedule total.

sop: Compare the PolicyCenter terms screen to the quote letter line by line.

sop: Check the line of business and risk territory against the scheduled authority.

verify: Compare the transaction class and state to the scheduled authority list.
Pass when both appear on the schedule or a referral exists.

steps.title: Check for risk appetite exceptions and rate deviations triggering referral
sop: Review appetite flags, prohibited class indicators and rate deviation warnings.

Done when every referral trigger is reviewed and actioned.
verify: List fired triggers on the transaction against raised referrals.
Pass when each fired trigger has a matching referral.

sop: Check the policy status reads In Force on the policy record.
